title: Heartstealer Mod
description: This mod adds new mechanics that make the game more competitive and challenging for Players who are chasing control over the server
body: The Heartstealer mod adds many new mechanics into minecraft including new weapons items and logic, killing to survive is the name of the game usually, but when killing some creatures give extreme power, players may fight over the power of hearts dropped by animals, but the most powerful hearts are dropped by the players themselves.
